structural_wiring_facts_verified_at_head.purpose: These code facts (verified read-only at HEAD 3079d69a) determine which cells can carry native coverage and what each cell's policy role is. They are recorded, not changed.
structural_wiring_facts_verified_at_head.driver_entry: solweig_light.radiation.cylinder_longwave.define_patch_characteristics_primary(*args, block_pixels=128, parallel=True) -- driver's OWN exact defaults: block_pixels=128, parallel=True (cylinder_longwave.py:356). The routing seam fires 'only when parallel and rows*cols' (n8_40_integration_record wiring_design), BEFORE the legacy block loop (cylinder_longwave.py:401-404).
structural_wiring_facts_verified_at_head.h_meaning_and_support: H = RuntimeOptions.threads_per_worker (the project's H=1/H=4 concurrency level; dossier 03_region_multicore.md 'H copies and simultaneous producers'; C6-01 paired_timing 'child-isolated H=1 vs H=4'). SUPPORTED: RuntimeOptions defaults threads_per_worker=1 (runtime.py:315-327), validated 1 <= H <= cpu_budget <= cpus (runtime.py:355-366); H=4 requires cpu_budget>=4. Materialized (a) for tile-worker children via _child_environment thread caps OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL/NUMEXPR/VECLIB/BLIS/NUMBA_NUM_THREADS + GDAL_CACHEMAX set before first import (runtime.py:663-684), and (b) for the in-process region pool via resolve_budget() reading get_runtime_options().threads_per_worker (region_pool.py:766-784). Per BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL, all H changes run in independent fresh child processes; actual pool sizes are verified inside the child, not assumed from env strings.
structural_wiring_facts_verified_at_head.pipeline_boundary_h1_gate: The public pipeline radiation wrappers pass parallel=(threads_per_worker > 1) and block_pixels=get_runtime_options().block_pixels (engine.py:1655, 1767, 1770, 1778). At the PUBLIC pipeline boundary with default options (H=1), parallel=False, the routing seam NEVER fires, resolve_lw_backend() is NOT consulted, and every arm executes the identical legacy serial kernel. Consequence recorded for the operator: under the wiring frozen at this HEAD, no registry content can make the no-env public default execute native at H=1; default-objective evidence ('ordinary wheel install/call ... native execution really occurs') cannot be produced through the pipeline wrappers without a separately reviewed code change. PROMOTION_POLICY's own fallback applies: if only tuned cells route native, report native opt-in success and default objective incomplete. This freeze changes nothing; cell n843-p1 measures and archives the fact empirically.
structural_wiring_facts_verified_at_head.registry_mechanics: resolve_lw_backend() (lw_default_policy.py:585) maps legacy env -> installed-artifact state -> qualification records onto rows: A legacy Numba dense kernels (cylinder_longwave._longwave_primary/_serial), B Numba AoSoA consumer (lw_b_control.lw_primary_b), C native AoSoA consumer (lw_native_aosoa.primary_aosoa). Rows B/C activate ONLY on a sw8-lw-default-row-record-v1 'qualified' record whose evidence still validates at resolve time; every absent/stale/malformed path fails CLOSED to row A. resolve_lw_backend() with no registry argument re-reads the shipped registry file on EVERY call -- the shipped state pays one small JSON stat+read per routed-eligible driver call in EVERY arm (row A pays it and declines). N7 fairness follows: the read exists in both arms and disappears only if an N8-41 caching variant is ever proposed. The expert env SOLWEIG_LIGHT_LW_BACKEND bypasses the selector entirely (served by the legacy B7-32 route in _lw_region_route); it must be UNSET in all three arms and its absence recorded per run.

arm_definitions.boundary: Driver boundary: one observation = one fresh child process executing ONE full 24-record pass of define_patch_characteristics_primary over the cell's prepared unchanged geometry (processed_inputs), publishing outputs durably. The public-pipeline boundary is used only by protected cell n843-p1 (see cells). Fresh child per observation satisfies 'Run in independent processes for H changes' universally, not only for H=4 cells.
arm_definitions.A0_current_default: Row A: shipped state at HEAD 3079d69a -- qualification registry absent/empty, SOLWEIG_LIGHT_LW_BACKEND unset. Execution: the driver's trusted legacy block loop with _lw_kernel(parallel) Numba kernels; the selector IS consulted (one resolve_lw_backend() per driver call, resolves [absent] -> row A -> None) and its cost stays IN the A0 arm (N7). This is the frozen current accepted Numba; it is never renamed as upstream.
arm_definitions.B1_strongest_equivalent_layout_numba: Row B via a benchmark-harness-only qualification record {schema sw8-lw-default-row-record-v1, status qualified, row B, ...} written into the shipped registry file (backup -> write -> restore around the run; NEVER via env, which would bypass the selector). Exact module/route: solweig_light._native_dispatch.region.consumers.AosoaBConsumer (mode SELF_PARALLEL -- the kernel's prange owns the granted budget) executing solweig_light._native_dispatch.lw_b_control.lw_primary_b over whole-scene direct_aosoa.produce_blocks_aosoa + classify_block_aosoa output, dispatched through region_pool.execute_regions.
arm_definitions.auto_installed_no_env_default: Row C via the candidate qualified-C record in the shipped registry file (same backup/restore discipline; env unset in every arm -- this is the arm whose registry content the campaign qualifies). Route: AosoaNativeCConsumer (mode BLOCK_FANOUT; per-block note-N6 float32 views of the raw uint32 producer feed) executing the N8-13 ISPC entry solweig_light._native_dispatch.lw_native_aosoa.primary_aosoa via the installed artifact loader; parallelism from the region owner at block level (the ISPC entry is single-threaded per call). Final env-unset candidate runs must use the packaged allow-list and cannot be a forced-native benchmark disguised as user default.

accounting_rules.N7_selector_read: One resolve_lw_backend() per routed-eligible driver call in BOTH (all three) arms; included in every arm's cost. Recorded per cell: the registry file path, its size, and the fact that row A pays the identical read.
accounting_rules.included_in_every_timed_observation: preparation (_class_coefficients prepared coefficients and geometry finalization), producer conversion (whole-scene produce_blocks_aosoa + classify_block_aosoa in arms B1/auto), policy checks, owner leases/scratch slots, decode, pool dispatch, both sweeps, synchronization (measured as completion, never enqueue time), output placement/reshape and durable output publication (I/O included; post-run output hashing performed OUTSIDE the timer as independent evidence analysis)
accounting_rules.excluded_and_labelled: harness/parent overhead, process spawn, and post-run hashing are outside the declared application boundary and are recorded as such
accounting_rules.actual_thread_counts_recorded_not_assume: each child records numba.get_num_threads() after setup, the region pool's resolved budget (resolve_budget result / pool stats worker count), and the region pool ExecutionMode; the harness archives these per observation and a cell whose recorded threads contradict its declared H is CENSORED (unmatched resource), not relabelled
accounting_rules.instrumentation_separation: in-child time.perf_counter aggregates only; detailed per-call timers and Path-method spys stay in separate diagnostic runs (never in timed observations)

memory_measurement_method.process_tree_peak_tool: RSSTreeSampler (existing in-repo method, tools/optimization_v8/n8_02_run.py:82): a daemon thread sampling every 0.15 s one 'ps -eo pid,ppid,rss,comm' snapshot (macOS rss KB x 1024 = bytes), walking the tree from the driver child's root PID down through all descendants via ppid, recording per-sample n_proc and sum_rss_bytes; reports peak_sum_rss_bytes (max over samples), mean_sum_rss_bytes, and per_pid_peak_rss_bytes. Parent ru_maxrss alone never qualifies memory; per-child ru_maxrss via wait4 is archived as corroborating per-member peaks.
memory_measurement_method.double_count_discipline: tree SUMS double-count shared pages (macOS ps has no PSS); peak_sum_rss_bytes is reported as an UPPER BOUND and is never an admission number -- the separate per-PID peaks and the n_proc count are archived so shared-page double-counting can be assessed independently (BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL memory/IO rule)

censor_rules.memory_pressure_kill: a memory-pressure kill is a failed/CENSORED run; a retry does not erase it; censored runs are preserved in the record with cause
censor_rules.single_retry: at most ONE rerun per censored observation, permitted only after a stated cause and a small repro/inspection; a second censor closes that cell for the campaign (reported, not erased)
censor_rules.invalidating_conditions: noisy host, unmatched layout/profile/resource (incl. recorded thread counts contradicting declared H), missing completed pair, or synthetic-only default extrapolation invalidates promotion evidence for the affected cell; unresolved host noise is insufficient evidence, never a pass
censor_rules.quiet_host_monitoring: read-only; may not terminate unrelated user applications; delay or mark uncertainty rather than consuming unlimited runs
censor_rules.parity_gate: per cell, the three arms' warm-pass outputs are compared bitwise (all 7 fields + metadata, exact finite bits, NaN/Inf masks separate) BEFORE any timed observation is credited; a parity failure closes the cell for the campaign (investigate via small repro; at most one rerun)

pairing_and_order_schedule.structure: 3 alternating paired observations per cell (finalist count per BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL); each pair is one observation of EACH arm in a frozen order, giving 3 paired A0-vs-auto and 3 paired B1-vs-auto observations per cell
pairing_and_order_schedule.schedule_properties: explicit alternating A/C-style order (no randomness to argue about post-hoc); B1 sits mid-triple in every pair so neither A0 nor auto systematically inherits the fresher cache state; identical schedule for every cell, declared before any run
pairing_and_order_schedule.warmup_policy: ONE untimed warm pass per arm per cell (identical fresh-child discipline, full 24-record pass) before pair 0; its outputs feed the parity gate; warm-pass raw data is archived but excluded from timed statistics; declared identical across arms
pairing_and_order_schedule.statistics: per-cell paired median ratios A0/auto and B1/auto over the 3 pairs; cross-cell geometric mean of A0/auto over native-eligible primary cells; all ratios labelled observed small-sample summaries, not significance claims
pairing_and_order_schedule.raw_data_preservation: every observation (warm or timed, clean or censored) is archived as an immutable JSON record: cell id, arm, schedule slot, child argv, deployment label (installed wheel vs labelled source-state), UTC start/end, loadavg start/end, memory-view at start, RSSTreeSampler archives, recorded thread counts and pool stats, coverage counters, output sha256 digests, censor cause if any; no record is ever overwritten or deleted

native_coverage_proof.unit: one completed pixel-row of the LW primary reduction per (record, pixel); required output computed by ACTUAL native region (primary_aosoa entry) for >= 80% of PREDECLARED eligible pixel-patch work in a primary cell = >= 80% of pixels x 24 records
native_coverage_proof.counters: counters incremented at actual C entry for COMPLETED pixel-patch work plus call counts, scalar/layout/profile and artifact generation stamp; build stamps or a loaded module alone do not prove execution; pre-launch fallbacks and errors counted separately; low-overhead aggregated counters in timed runs, detailed per-call timers only in separate diagnostic runs; mask/mixed regions counted once under the defined non-double-counted row unit
native_coverage_proof.deployment: native wheel host must execute meaningful native work; pure-source/no-native fallback runs correctly and is labelled fallback; the two are never interchanged (VALIDATION_POLICY default test boundary)
